proposals.title: NFT London - Lil activation for Lil Nouns
proposals.tldr: Attend NFT LDN satellite events and spread the Lil Nouns gospel by word of mouth and leafleting/sticker placements.
proposals.content:
# **Who**

My name is Cardno (https://twitter.com/CardnoNFT ) and I am a twitter spaces co-host for The Lil Nouns Show (https://twitter.com/TheLilNounsShow) as well as being an active member of the community on discord.

# What

I would like to travel to NFT LDN on the 4th November 2022 in order to highlight the Lil Nouns project via word of mouth and leaflets/stickers/merch.

# **Where**

I will spend the day in and around the Queen Elizabeth II conference centre. London, UK.

# Wen!...Roadmap

18 Oct - 24 Oct 22 - Lil Prop House submissions window. Prop submitted 18 Oct 22.

24 Oct - 28 Oct 22 - Lil Prop House voting window. **Due to needing to order leaflets, stickers and merchandise in advance, I will make a judgement call during this week. If I feel the prop has enough votes behind it to pass, I will place an order for the above out of my own pocket. If it turns out that I do indeed miss out on funding, then I will bare this cost myself and still go ahead with the planned event. **

29 Oct - 3 Nov 22 - Take delivery of leaflets, stickers and merchandise.

4 Nov 22 - Travel to London and proliferate the meme.

# Why

From my research, albeit limited, I do not think there is going to be a Lil Nouns presence OTG at NFT LDN. Were this to be a round with higher funding I would of questioned the ROI myself but being as this is a larger, lower funded round, I believe it has merit.

# Current progress

I will be purchasing and bringing with me a number of items that include leaflets (these are yet to be designed and I will look to consult with community members this week on the most impactful approach for an A5 leaflet), stickers and tote bags. The same design will be used on the tote bags and the stickers which features some of the social media accounts/spaces run in our ecosystem (**@TheLilNounsShow / @LilNouners / @LilSistersFund / @LilPropHouse) **in the hope of driving traffic towards our social media accounts and raising awareness of our myriad of sub accounts. The stickers will be die cut around the noggles and I've included an image of some other sticker designs using the same method. Some mock up designs can be seen below:

![](https://i.ibb.co/GQzF0bp/Screenshot-tote.png)

![](https://i.ibb.co/frLwynx/Glasses-red-lil-sisters.png)

![](https://i.ibb.co/f47rJZB/Screenshot-2022-10-18-175631.png)

# **Budget**

**Awarded:** 0.5 (£578.50 at time of writing).

**Custom tote bags:** £256.78 (x25).

**Die cut vinyl stickers:** £141.00 (x200).

**Leaflets:** £31.50 - £35.00 (dependent on final design x250).

**Travel:** £96.30 via train

**Remaining budget:** £49.42

I appreciate you taking the time to read my prop. If you have any questions then don't hesitate to reach out to me on twitter @cardnoNFT or discord #Cardno0446.
